title: Thai panang-style curry
ingredients: 2 tbsp panang or red curry paste
A handful of green beans or snap peas
Lime and Thai basil or cilantro
steps: Simmer 1/2 cup coconut milk with curry paste until oily and fragrant.
Add remaining coconut milk, fish sauce, and sugar.
Add chicken and simmer until just cooked, 8–10 minutes.
Add vegetables and cook until crisp-tender. Finish with lime and herbs. Serve over rice.
